C1748.title: Poisoning Attacks Against Machine Learning: Can ML Be Trusted?
C1748.summary: A NIST publication highlights that a key threat to machine learning systems involves attackers controlling training data or the training process to alter model predictions on specific test inputs at deployment. The attack has a long history, dating back to early work on worm signature development.
